evidence_spans: The smallest filament-segment width in the final inverse-designed heater is 280.6 nm, and the smallest edge-to-edge spacing between neighboring filaments is 502.3 nm.

These dimensions are substantially larger than the corresponding values of 280.6 nm and 502.3 nm in the 1µm-cell design, demonstrating the improvement in fabrication tolerance obtained by increasing the cell size.
The updated powers are converted into a new linewidth map using Eqs. (9)–(13), after which the nonlinear electrothermal model is solved again.
